_week: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-15 (Week 46), MAC Energy US. Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Sales rose 26.3% to $100,411, but ad spend more than doubled (+147%) to $84,752, so TACoS jumped from 43.2% to 84.4%.
The Variety Pack led (+36.7% to $47,625, 47% of sales). Green Apple +26.6%, Orange Creamsicle +25.9%, Macberry Lychee +14.1%, Proper Punch +7.3%.
refunds: Refunds were $1,406 (2.2% refund rate), down from $1,584 the week before. A small share of sales; no action needed.
pacing_reco: November is $193,243 through Nov 15; at $12,883 a day it lands near $386,487, below October's $483,507. Ad spend is $127,521 month to date.
ads_context: Ad spend went from $34,333 to $84,752, while ad sales grew only 15% to $45,440.
ACoS rose from 87.1% to 186.5%: each $1 of ads now brings $0.54 of ad sales (was $1.15).
ads_strategy: Category keywords took $34,923 for $11,857 (294.5% ACoS), up from $8,800. Competitor targeting: $31,117 for $14,114 (220.5%).
Branded keywords returned $5,294 on $1,480 (28.0% ACoS). Auto was cut to $2,611 (was $9,060).
bid_moves: Cut the three Green Apple category campaigns: $23,284 spent for $7,871 in sales (broad 352%, exact 219%, phrase 376%).
Raise budget on the Orange Creamsicle brand-exact campaign: $767 brought $3,376 (22.7% ACoS).
coupons: This week: 589 coupon orders (613 last week).
November so far: 1,343 coupon orders through Nov 15.
promotions: This week: 1,700 promotion orders and $17,175 in promotional discounts (vs 1,692 and $19,136 last week).
Payout fell to -$44,158 from -$9,207, driven by the extra $50,419 of ad spend.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
